notes: Ruling (rule 11): first-person narrative with implicit transmission. أبي عطية relates his own visit with Masruq to Aisha; her answer («هكذا كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يصنع») is the saying, and the text writes no transmission from her. Masruq is in the scene. Aisha is not added pending the ruling
«قال دخلت أنا ومسروق» is an encounter in the report's own words, not a route
